newsitem.title: MEXICO: Hylsamex says to invest $370 mln.
newsitem.headline: Hylsamex says to invest $370 mln.

text.p: Mexican steel firm Hylsamex said on Monday it would invest $370 million during 1997 and 1998.
"We expect to invest $230 million in 1997 and $140 million during 1998, which totals $370 million," the firm's director general Alejandro Elizondo said.

He told a news conference that $140 million would go into the second stage of a flat steel minimill, which should enable it to double production of hot-rolled steel from 750,000 to 1.5 million tonnes a year.
Another $73 million, he added, would go to building new production lines to increase installed capacity, and $52 million would go to the Hylsamex plant in Puebla for a new oven and other equipment.
